name: SCW Florida Tag-Team Titles
caption: Retained by Hearts of Darkness (Matt Moyer and Rex Stone) against The Warlords on the CWF branch show; the fed's own record does not survive to show when they were won.
epitaph: SCW Florida Tag-Team Titles of SCW ENTITY A: the surviving 1997 Usenet record shows the reigns listed here and nothing of how the belt ended.

name: SCW Florida Heavyweight Title
caption: Vacant as of the CWF branch show, where a match to fill it (Billy Joe Pherris vs. Adrian 'Tiger' Lee) was set up going into a commercial break; no Part II survives to show the result.
epitaph: SCW Florida Heavyweight Title of SCW ENTITY A: the surviving 1997 Usenet record shows the reigns listed here and nothing of how the belt ended.

name: SCW National Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Vacated after a chaotic four-way cage match, refilled in an eight-man Tower of Doom cage match at the Continental Cup, defended to a time-limit draw, then changed hands in a rematch billed "Chapman/Spencer II."

name: SCW Television Championship
epitaph: Changed hands on the promotion's own season-opening broadcast, later stripped from a champion whose own path to the belt the promotion judged illegitimate, and refilled in a bloody three-way Dog Collar match at the promotion's own first pay-per-view.

name: SCW Television Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Changed hands on the promotion's own season-opening broadcast, then again at the promotion's own first pay-per-view, where the winning team included a masked returnee revealed after the bell.

name: SCW Tennessee Championship
epitaph: Changed hands on the promotion's own season-opening broadcast with an assist from a masked-off ally at ringside.

name: SCW Brass Knux Championship
epitaph: Created to replace a retired Cruiserweight title; its own first defense at the Continental Cup ended with both men knocked out through a table, and the belt was held up before changing hands again by the promotion's own first pay-per-view.

name: SCW Southern States Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Changed hands at the Continental Cup in a title-for-title Dog Collar match against a rival promotion's own Florida title.

name: SCW Southern States Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Held by two different teams across 1999 before falling vacant and being refilled in a three-way scaffold match at the promotion's own first pay-per-view.

name: SCW National Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Created as the Continental Cup tag tournament's own prize, and retained by disqualification against Domination at the promotion's own first pay-per-view.
